Let ActionBrain read your chat notifications?

ActionBrain can read the notifications that your chat apps show on this phone, so tasks and promises in your messages reach your Inbox without you copying them.

What it reads: the sender name and message text of notifications from the chat apps you switch on in ActionBrain Settings (for example WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams). Notifications from other apps are ignored.

What happens to it: the text is sent over an encrypted connection to your own ActionBrain account and kept in your Inbox. It is sent to your AI provider only when you press Analyze, using your own key. It is never sold or used for advertising.

You can pause it from the Quick Settings tile, switch apps off in ActionBrain Settings, or turn notification access off in Android Settings at any time.
Use the microphone to record?

ActionBrain uses the microphone only while you are recording (after you press Record), to turn speech into text.

The speech is transcribed on this phone. The audio is not uploaded. Only the text is saved to your ActionBrain account, and it is sent to your AI provider only when you press Analyze.

It never records in the background, and you can stop at any time.

Allow ActionBrain to read chats?

ActionBrain can read the messages shown on your screen while a chat is open, so tasks and promises made in a live conversation reach your Inbox.

What it reads: only the chat name and the message text in the chat apps you switch on in ActionBrain Settings (WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business, and Microsoft Teams if you switch it on), including your own messages. It does not read other apps, and it does not read what you type.

What happens to it: the text is sent to your own ActionBrain account and kept in your Inbox. It is sent to your AI provider only when you press Analyze, using your own key. It is never sold or used for advertising.

The people you chat with have not agreed to this. Use the allowed-senders list in Settings to limit it to chats you choose.

You can switch it off at any time in Android Settings → Accessibility, or by removing ActionBrain there.
Capture Microsoft Teams messages?
ActionBrain will read the notifications that Microsoft Teams shows on this phone (who wrote the message, and its text) and send them to your Inbox.

If you also turn on live chat reading, it will read the chat name and message text of a Teams chat while it is open on screen, including your own messages. It does not read other apps, and it does not read what you type.

The text is sent to your own ActionBrain account and kept in your Inbox. It is sent to your AI provider only when you press Analyze, using your own key. It is never sold or used for advertising.

These are work messages, and the people in them have not agreed to this. Check that your organisation allows it.

You can switch Teams off at any time in ActionBrain Settings.

Make ActionBrain your assistant?

Then, in any WhatsApp or Teams chat, long-press the power or home button and ActionBrain reads that one screen.

What it reads: the chat name and the messages visible at that moment, only when you long-press. Never in the background, never what you type.

What happens to it: you see how many messages were found and nothing is sent until you tap Send. Then they go to your own ActionBrain Inbox over an encrypted connection, and to your AI provider only when analysed with your own key.

This replaces your current assistant (for example Google Assistant or Gemini) for the long-press. You can switch back at any time in Android Settings → Default apps → Digital assistant app.
